verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets in-product AI agents for customer screening/ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. The agents auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review, so AI does act on the user's data inside the product. The evidence is thin marketing copy, though, and describes automated triage rather than insights or suggestions surfaced to the user, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: explicit AI-generated insights or recommendations shown to users, detailed first-party docs on agent outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
